description: First-person arms cut out of a rigged + animated Library character (animation kit preferred): keeps the skeleton, the 23 clips and the materials, drops every triangle that is not skinned to the arm chains. The player then sees the same gloves/sleeves the others see on the body, and weapons attach on RightHand with the gripforge_attach binds. New Library item. 0 credits.
